name: Policy Page Template
summary: Readable legal-content composition with a dated header, optional table of contents, and target-owned semantic rich body.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Policy title and update metadata region.

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: Optional visible last-updated date supplied and formatted by the target.

anatomy.name: tocLink
anatomy.description: In-page link to a target-supplied policy section.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Target-owned semantic legal content preserving headings, paragraphs, lists, links, media, tables, and code where present.

states.name: tocLinkFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on table-of-contents links.

states.name: bodyLinkFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on links within policy content.

behavior.name: tableOfContents
behavior.description: When supplied, table-of-contents links target stable section identifiers in the same document and preserve body-section order. Generation and synchronization remain target-owned.

behavior.name: legalContentBoundary
behavior.description: The target supplies semantic legal content. This contract styles the resulting document but does not define a CMS schema, revision model, localization pipeline, or policy-source API.

properties.name: updatedDate
properties.description: Optional target-formatted visible last-updated date; machine-readable date semantics remain markup-owned.

properties.name: tocItems
properties.description: Target-owned in-page links ordered to match policy sections.

accessibility: Use one page-level title followed by a logical, non-skipping heading hierarchy in the policy body.
Render a visible last-updated date when supplied and use machine-readable date markup when the target has an exact value.
Keep table-of-contents links in document order and point each link to a unique section identifier.
Preserve semantic lists, tables, links, quotations, and other legal-content structures from the target source.
Keep long text, media, tables, and code contained at narrow widths without removing keyboard access to horizontal overflow.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/pages.css; legal content and table-of-contents generation remain target-owned.

shopify.notes: Should map target policy content without this contract defining Shopify or cross-target CMS ownership.
